description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDecorator class, which provides additional methods to interact with EmployeeEducation entities, including setting related Employee and Education entities and formatting start/end dates. It acts as a decorator for managing employee education details within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides helper methods for EmployeeEducation entities, including setting related entities and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeEducation object.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeEducation entity being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the EmployeeEducation by employee number.

methods.name: setEducationByEducationId
methods.description: Sets the Education entity associated with the EmployeeEducation by education ID.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the employee education record.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the employee education record.
